title: Lower bound for the Fourier correlation function
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function that is odd, so that $f(\lnot x)=-f(x)$ for all $x$, and $\pm 1$-valued, so that $f(x)\in\{-1,1\}$ for all $x$. Then its Fourier correlation function satisfies
\[
  \mathrm{corr}(f) \;=\; \sum_{S\subseteq[n]} \hat f(S)^2\,(-1/3)^{|S|} \;\ge\; -\tfrac13,
\]
where $\hat f(S)$ denotes the Fourier--Walsh coefficient of $f$ at frequency $S$.
hypotheses_covered: f is an odd Boolean function: f(¬x) = −f(x)
